Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol (w/ Power Rebuild). Holds 8 rounds. Despite being Iconic, it can still load Explosive Ammunition. Sets damaged targets Seriously on Fire. Incompatible with Pistol Autosear.

Variant of: Metel
Category: Expensive
Fabrication: DV21 - 500eb - 1 Week
Class: Poor Quality Very Heavy Pistol
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
